knowledge.q: How many trophies are there in GTA 6?
knowledge.text: The number isn’t published as of October 4, 2026: neither PlayStation, Xbox nor Rockstar has released the list. All we know is that the Xbox page announces achievements, and that Microsoft caps a game at 1,000 achievement points at launch. For comparison, GTA V had 51 trophies in its base game.
knowledge.status: Answer from the “Trophies and achievements” FAQ, sources at the bottom of the page

knowledge.q: How do you get the GTA 6 Platinum trophy?
knowledge.text: On PlayStation, the Platinum unlocks once you’ve earned all the game’s other trophies. For GTA VI, neither the list nor the Platinum has been published. A creator invited by Rockstar talks about a hundred hours or so, solo, but that’s not an official announcement. In GTA V, the “Los Santos Legend” Platinum also required GTA Online trophies.

knowledge.q: Are there missable trophies in GTA 6?
knowledge.text: Nothing is published: we’ll know once the list is out, and every missable trophy will be flagged here. In GTA V, PowerPyx counted six, mostly tied to the story’s final choice.

knowledge.q: Will there be online trophies in GTA 6?
knowledge.text: None have been announced. Rockstar presents GTA VI as a single-player experience at launch, and the list isn’t published. In GTA V, 34 of the 78 trophies were tied to GTA Online.
knowledge.status: Answer from the “Trophies and achievements” FAQ, sources at the bottom of the page

knowledge.q: When will the trophy list be published?
knowledge.text: No date has been announced. Specialist sites note that these lists usually show up a few days before release; GTA VI comes out on November 19, 2026, and the boxed version, a download code, arrives as early as November 12 for preloading.

knowledge.q: How do I track my trophies on Leonidakit?
knowledge.text: Each trophy will have its “Earned” box, saved on your device only, with the percentage and the progress ring. Nothing is sent anywhere else, and no account is needed.
